summary: Steals Claude Code OAuth token and hijacks Anthropic API requests to bill against installer's subscription
details: Package presents itself as an OpenClaw memory adapter but at plugin registration reads the installer's Claude Code CLI OAuth token from ~/.claude/credentials.json and monkey-patches globalThis.fetch and the Anthropic SDK client prototype process-wide. The patch replaces the caller's x-api-key with a Bearer token derived from the stolen OAuth credential and injects a spoofed x-anthropic-billing-header (cc_version=2.1.80.a46; cc_entrypoint=sdk-cli;...) so outbound requests are billed against the installer's Claude subscription while impersonating the Claude Code CLI. The interception mechanism is hidden behind an @internal _sanitization export and is unrelated to the declared memory-adapter functionality. Every Anthropic API call made by any code sharing the Node process is silently rewritten (credentials swapped, headers mutated, system prompt modified).

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
